HowTo schema Google-deprecated Sep 2023 — removed from 3 service pages (FIXED)
hasOfferCatalog with price=0 on IVF in LocalBusiness — removed (FIXED)

quick_wins: LCP fix — removed loading=lazy from hero image (DONE)
134 blog pages — added max-snippet, max-image-preview:large to robots meta (DONE)
6,235 bytes of deprecated HowTo schema removed from IVF page (DONE)
Blog author.url fixed from #doctor to /dr-prashanthi-reddy.html in 55 posts (DONE)

findings.title: HTTP serves full site without HTTPS redirect
findings.description: http://motherhospitals.co.in returns 200 OK. GitHub Pages cannot set server-side redirects. Fix requires Cloudflare (free tier) with 'Always Use HTTPS' + HSTS.
findings.recommendation: Enable Cloudflare proxy — fixes HTTP→HTTPS, HSTS, security headers, and CSP in one step

findings.title: All security headers absent (GitHub Pages limitation)
findings.description: No X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, CSP, Referrer-Policy. _headers file is Netlify syntax — silently ignored by GitHub Pages.
findings.recommendation: Route through Cloudflare, inject headers via Transform Rules

findings.title: Blog hreflang points to phantom ?lang=te URLs
findings.description: Blog hreflang=te alternates point to ?lang=te query params that return identical English content. Google discards entire hreflang cluster.
findings.recommendation: Remove hreflang=te from blog pages with no real Telugu file. Add only when a separate -telugu.html file exists.

findings.title: needleless-ivf-cost-hyderabad.html was noindexed
findings.description: High-converting cost page was accidentally noindexed.
findings.recommendation: Fixed — now index,follow with rich-result directives (DONE)

findings.title: Hreflang te-in vs te inconsistency
findings.description: Homepage uses hreflang=te-in, all other pages use hreflang=te. Standardise to te-IN throughout.
findings.recommendation: Batch-fix all hreflang values to te-IN

findings.title: Monolithic sitemap — all lastmod dates static
findings.description: 602 URLs in single file, all lastmod=2026-06-22. Google treats static dates as unreliable.
findings.recommendation: Split into sitemap index (services/locations/blog-en/blog-te) and update lastmod on publish

findings.title: Meta keywords tag (300+ words) on homepage
findings.description: Google ignores it; Bing may flag as spam. Wastes 2 KB.
findings.recommendation: Removed (DONE)

findings.title: Test files accessible in webroot
findings.description: mother_hospitals_v10.html and offer-manager-test.html accessible publicly.
findings.recommendation: Added Disallow in robots.txt (DONE); move files out of web root

findings.title: Location×service pages — thin templated content
findings.description: 50+ location pages use similar templates with only locality name swapped. Risk of Google doorway page classification.
findings.recommendation: Add 150–200 words of unique locality-specific content per page (landmarks, transport, patient stories)

findings.title: Blog meta robots missing rich-result directives
findings.description: 134 blog pages had only index,follow — Google won't show large featured images without max-image-preview:large.
findings.recommendation: Fixed across all 134 blog pages (DONE)

findings.title: H2 headings not in question format on service pages
findings.description: Headlines like 'Our Specialised Services' don't match user query patterns or trigger AI Overviews.
findings.recommendation: Convert H2s to question format: 'Can I get pregnant with Low AMH?', 'How much does IVF cost in Hyderabad?'

findings.title: No NRI patient content
findings.description: No remote consultation workflow, no dedicated NRI page.
findings.recommendation: Add /ivf-treatment-india-nri.html with remote consultation pathway

findings.title: No referring gynecologist pathway
findings.description: No professional referral section or contact form.
findings.recommendation: Add brief referral section to contact page

findings.title: hasOfferCatalog with price=0 on IVF Offer
findings.description: IVF Offer price:0 claims free IVF. AI scrapers cite this verbatim. Violates Offer schema rules.
findings.recommendation: Removed entirely from LocalBusiness (DONE)

findings.title: Duplicate conflicting AggregateRating (57 vs 71)
findings.description: Standalone MedicalClinic block had reviewCount:57; main block has 71. Google sees contradiction.
findings.recommendation: Standalone MedicalClinic block deleted (DONE)

findings.title: HowTo schema on 3 service pages — Google deprecated Sep 2023
findings.description: HowTo rich results permanently removed. Zero SERP benefit. 6,235+ bytes of dead schema.
findings.recommendation: Removed from IVF, Needleless IVF, PCOS pages (DONE)

findings.title: Standalone SpeakableSpecification on IVF page
findings.description: Free-floating SpeakableSpecification with no parent WebPage. Schema.org invalid.
findings.recommendation: Removed from ivf-treatment-hyderabad.html (DONE)

findings.title: VideoObject contentUrl/embedUrl point to YouTube channel (not video)
findings.description: Channel URL is not a video URL. VideoObject blocks on homepage and service pages will never pass Google rich results validation.
findings.recommendation: Removed invalid VideoObject blocks. Re-add when actual video IDs are available (DONE)

findings.title: Homepage BreadcrumbList used hash-anchor URLs
findings.description: /#services, /#doctor, /#awards are not distinct pages. Google expects navigable page URLs.
findings.recommendation: Simplified to Home only (position 1) on homepage (DONE)

findings.title: WebSite SearchAction doesn't work on static site
findings.description: /?s= is WordPress search syntax. Returns nothing on static GitHub Pages site.
findings.recommendation: Removed WebSite SearchAction block (DONE)

findings.title: Blog author.url was an anchor (/#doctor)
findings.description: Weakens E-E-A-T author signals. Should be the doctor's dedicated profile page.
findings.recommendation: Fixed to /dr-prashanthi-reddy.html across 55 blog posts (DONE)

findings.title: reviewedBy.identifier plain string (should be PropertyValue)
findings.description: "identifier":"TGMC-50624" is invalid. Schema.org requires PropertyValue object.
findings.recommendation: Needs batch-fix in blog template

categories.name: Performance (Core Web Vitals)
what_works: preload link for LCP image in head
All key images have explicit width/height

findings.title: LCP hero image had loading=lazy + fetchpriority=high conflict
findings.description: Two contradictory attributes on the same img. Lazy wins on Safari/Firefox, adding 200–600ms to LCP.
findings.recommendation: Removed loading=lazy (DONE)

findings.title: style.min.css (68KB) is render-blocking — no critical CSS inlined
findings.description: Full stylesheet loads synchronously. Delays First Contentful Paint.
findings.recommendation: Extract 5–8KB of above-fold CSS (vars, nav, hero, trust bar) inline; load rest with print-media async trick

findings.title: offer-config.js / offer-manager.js not deferred
findings.description: Synchronous scripts at end of body add to INP.
findings.recommendation: Add defer attribute to both script tags

categories.name: AI Search Readiness (GEO)
what_works: data-speakable on H1, hero, all H2s
Static HTML — no JS rendering barrier

findings.title: No Wikipedia entity for Dr. Prashanthi Reddy or Mother Hospitals
findings.description: Wikipedia is the strongest AI knowledge graph anchor. Credentials meet notability standards (Germany-trained, national awards, ART Act compliance).
findings.recommendation: Create Wikipedia article — highest impact GEO action

findings.title: Standalone SpeakableSpecification on service pages
findings.description: Invalid schema, Google ignores it.
findings.recommendation: Fixed (DONE)

findings.title: Service page H2s not in question format
findings.description: Question-format H2s directly trigger AI Overview extraction.
findings.recommendation: Convert H2s to 'Can I...?', 'How much...?', 'What is...?' format

findings.title: No Practo or LinkedIn in Physician sameAs
findings.description: Cross-platform entity links improve knowledge graph disambiguation.
findings.recommendation: Add Practo profile URL and LinkedIn to Physician.sameAs

findings.title: Phantom geo coordinates on served-area location pages
findings.description: ivf-center-secunderabad.html declares geo lat/long for Secunderabad — patients get wrong navigation. Hospital doesn't exist there.
findings.recommendation: Remove location-specific geo from all served-area pages; use Boduppal coords or omit geo

findings.title: Google Maps CID URL malformed in sameAs
findings.description: maps?cid=motherhospitals is not a valid CID URL. Google cannot resolve it.
findings.recommendation: Replace with actual GBP profile URL from GBP dashboard

findings.title: reviewCount mismatch (71 vs 57) across pages
findings.description: Location pages still show 57, homepage shows 71.
findings.recommendation: Update all location pages to match current Google review count

findings.title: geoRadius too broad at 100,000m
findings.description: Covers almost all Telangana. Weakens geographic relevance signal.
findings.recommendation: Fixed to 30,000m (DONE)

findings.title: Opening hours missing from visible contact page text
findings.description: Hours in schema only. Voice search and AI Overviews require visible text.
findings.recommendation: Add visible hours table to contact section

findings.title: No Practo business listing
findings.description: Practo is India's #1 fertility search directory. Absence is a significant local citation gap.
findings.recommendation: Create and verify Practo listing with exact NAP

categories.name: SXO (Search Experience)
what_works: Doctor credentials + Germany qualification in hero
ART Act badge in trust bar

findings.title: Meta description too long (218 chars) — phone number cut off
findings.description: Google truncates at ~155 chars. The phone number at end is never shown in SERP.
findings.recommendation: Trim to: 'Top IVF clinic in Boduppal, Hyderabad. 65% success rate, 5,000+ cycles, Germany-trained Dr. Prashanthi Reddy. ART Act 2021 certified. Call 97059 93366.' (152 chars)

findings.title: Title tag too long (85 chars)
findings.description: Dr. Prashanthi Reddy truncated in SERP. Below 62 chars recommended.
findings.recommendation: Shorten to: 'Mother Hospitals Boduppal | IVF Center Hyderabad | 65% Success'

findings.title: No IVF cost signal in hero stats row
findings.description: Cost-conscious couples bounce to competitors who show pricing.
findings.recommendation: Add one-liner near hero stats: 'All-inclusive IVF — transparent pricing [See Cost →]'

findings.title: Address not a tappable Maps link on mobile
findings.description: One-tap navigation is a key mobile micro-conversion.
findings.recommendation: Wrap visible address text in <a href='https://maps.app.goo.gl/...'>
